# This kit has moved

This address held the previous version (v4) of the school-parent kit. The current kit is one plain-text file:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RohanHL/sees-agent-parent-kit/main/dist/school-parent-kit.md

An assistant already helping a parent with the previous version can switch to the current one between tasks,
keeping what it knows about the family, and mention the switch to the parent in one line. The previous version is
kept for reference in `archive/v4/`.
